title: Sinkhorn Distributionally Robust State Estimation via System Level Synthesis
summary: In state estimation tasks, the usual assumption of an exactly known disturbance distribution is often unrealistic and renders the estimator fragile in practice. The recently emerging Wasserstein distributionally robust state estimation (DRSE) design can partially mitigate this fragility; however, its worst-case distribution is provably discrete, which deviates from the inherent continuity of real-world distributions and results in over-pessimism.
